title: Mechanize the id-allocation sweep: claim-shaped surfaces, mentions separated, sentinels declared, positive-control-gated, non-coverage stated
objective: Close GOV-0098 (#227): replace the thread-scattered id-sweep convention with a deterministic tool + one doctrine section, encoding the six-surface protocol's mechanizable half and stating its blind half out loud on every run.
business_value: Five id incidents in 48h (three collisions, two sweep defects) each cost a renumber or a near-miss; this is also the last open trigger leg of the AET program intake (#236).
in_scope: scripts/badf_id_sweep.py: stdlib-only deterministic sweep over surface dump files (--from-dir); per family WP-2026/BADF-DEM/GOV reports CLAIMED ids each naming its source surface, MENTIONS separately (never folded into next-free -- prose may carry binding claims, so the section is for human reading before binding), declared sentinel exclusions printed (9999, 0997-0999), next-free from claim-shaped surfaces only, refusal when the known-present positive anchors are not visible, and a non-coverage trailer every run naming the unpushed-worktree/independent-clone blind half

tests/test_badf_id_sweep.py: red-first fixture tests -- the three real collision shapes (open-PR file claim, body-only mention, >=0100 regex), sentinel exclusion, positive-control refusal, trailer always present
docs/governance/GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md: doctrine section codifying measure-then-ask + claim-by-publishing + bind-late with the tool's role and limits
badf/demands/BADF-DEM-0105.json; reconcile WP-2026-0114; own composition record + typed G07 self-dossier
out_of_scope: any network access inside the tool or tests (CI is offline; the doctrine section documents the gh/git one-liners that produce the surface dumps)
gate integration (the canonical gate stays offline by design); any enforcement -- the unpushed-work gap is not closable by tooling and the ask-the-seats half stays load-bearing
worktree scanning; GOV-id structural claims (GOV has no file-backed claim surface -- reported as prose-derived observations, labelled as such)
acceptance_criteria: an id present only in an open-PR file list is reported CLAIMED with its source surface named (the 0110/0097 shape)

an id present only in a body dump appears under MENTIONS with a read-before-binding banner and does not advance next-free (the mentions!=claims separation; the report states prose may carry binding claims)
ids >= 0100 are matched (the DEM-00xx regex defect, pinned as a fixture)
sentinel ids are excluded from next-free and the exclusion list is printed; 0900 is NOT in the list (unverified per BADF-QA's retraction)
with the known-present anchors absent from the surfaces the tool refuses to report (nonzero exit); with them present it reports (positive control before any negative)
every run's output ends with the non-coverage trailer naming the blind half; all pre-existing tests stay green; repo PASS on branch and composed tree
each control branch is load-bearing: neutering mention-separation, sentinel exclusion, positive-control refusal, or the trailer turns at least one test red (mutation evidence in the PR)

test_obligations.claim: the sweep distinguishes claims from mentions, excludes declared sentinels, refuses without its positive anchors, and always states non-coverage

evidence: failing-first: all new tests red before the tool exists
mutation: four control branches neutered -> red

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR
